narrative.overview:
Nexus is a sturdy hardware panel for a home: clear switches, status lamps and big readouts, read from a seat away and tapped in passing. Every surface is a slab with a thick ink outline and a hard offset shadow, as if cut from board and screwed onto the desk. Controls are chunky and clicky. They stand proud of the panel and press flat when tapped, so a tap feels like pushing a real button.

The deck has two equal finishes. **Cream paper** has black ink outlines. **Near-black** has bone-coloured outlines. Every colour is a `light-dark()` pair, so a screen is designed once and must read just as well in both themes. One colour carries the identity: Nexus Green, on the logo, the active page, the play button and every healthy status lamp. Everything else is ink, paper and three status colours.

Density is low on purpose. The clock and the readings are the largest things on screen, the status strip is a row of lamps, and a healthy day reads as calm. It must never slide into the generic admin-panel look of thin grey hairlines and small text, and it must never go soft: no blur, no glass, no gradients.
keyCharacteristics: 3px ink outlines on every surface and control. Weight is the structure.
Hard offset shadows with no blur (6px on cards, 4px on controls). They are the only source of depth.
Pressing a control moves it into its shadow (4px down and right, shadow gone) in 75ms.
One brand colour (Nexus Green) plus paper, ink and status colours, every one defined for both themes.
Heavy rounded system type with tabular figures, and huge readouts for distance reading.
Touch targets of 48px or more everywhere.

rules.name: The Two Finishes Rule
rules.body: Every colour is declared as `light-dark(paper, dark)` in the `@theme` block in `apps/web/src/index.css`, and nowhere else. A colour written for one theme only is a bug.

rules.name: The Ink Draws Everything Rule
rules.body: Outlines and shadows use Ink Line, never a tint, grey or transparent black. A border that has to be quieter gets thinner (2px, as on lamps and bars), not lighter.

rules.name: The Lamp Rule
rules.body: A status is a round lamp with an ink ring: green for healthy, red for a problem, Ink Dim for unknown or not set up. Never colour alone: the lamp always has a text label next to it.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Anything that changes while you watch (clock, timer, progress times, temperatures, percentages) uses tabular figures, so digits never shift.

rules.name: The Weight Not Size Rule
rules.body: Inside a card, hierarchy comes from weight (900 against 400) and from Ink against Ink Dim before size. Small grey type is for metadata only.

rules.name: The Kiosk First Rule
rules.body: Design at the Redmi kiosk (landscape, 970×436 CSS pixels) first, then check a tablet (1280×800), a phone (390px wide) and a laptop. Nothing may need hover. Nothing may scroll sideways.

rules.name: The Hard Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are solid ink, offset down and to the right, with 0 blur. Never `blur`, `backdrop-filter`, `drop-shadow` or gradients.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: Anything with a Key shadow is a control and must press into it on `:active` (75ms). Anything that does not press does not get a Key shadow.

dos: **Do** outline every surface and control at 3px in Ink Line, and give cards the 6px Slab shadow and controls the 4px Key shadow.
**Do** make every control at least 48×48px, and give it the press-in `:active` state.
**Do** define every new colour as a `light-dark()` pair in `@theme`, and check the screen in both themes before calling it done.
**Do** put Nexus Green on the identity and on on, active or healthy states, with black text on it.
**Do** make readouts big, heavy and tabular, and keep secondary text in Ink Dim at body or label size.
**Do** show a missing integration as a hidden card or plain "not set up" text, never as an error.
donts: **Don't** use blurred shadows, glass or `backdrop-filter`, gradients, or soft elevation. Depth is hard ink shadows only.
**Don't** build the generic admin-panel look: thin grey 1px borders, small dense tables, light grey text on white.
**Don't** use colour alone for status. A lamp always has a text label.
**Don't** load web fonts, icon fonts or anything from a CDN. Fonts are the system rounded face and icons are inline SVG paths.
**Don't** rotate anything except the Nexus logo plate.
